data.name: A Haunting Novel: Surfaced Secrets Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
Elephant Games brings you the latest chilling mystery in the A Haunting Novel series!

Your son and new daughter-in-law are returning from their honeymoon at sea, and you couldn’t be more excited to celebrate their return! That is until a spirit’s presence makes itself known, and the newlyweds disappear from your yacht! With only ghostly traces left behind as clues, it’s time to call in help from your old friend David Blackthorn. Can you work together to uncover secrets once hidden in the depths of the sea and save your son in time? Find out in this thrilling Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Uncover why a ghostly yacht is seen at the city pier. Learn Jack Blue’s connection – and what frees his spirit!

  • Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games - and earn achievements!

  • Many clever collectibles to discover! Find them all! Then get more character info - and play the bonus puzzle.

  • Enjoy and save exclusive wallpapers, screensavers, music, concept art, and more!

  • Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game - a sub genre of point & click adventure. Follow protagonists on a story-driven quest, find cleverly hidden objects, and solve various puzzles to advance the plot.
